title: How remediation flows end to end

steps.title: Prioritised work package
steps.text: Ranked by risk reduction versus implementation effort
steps.label: Owner: programme team

steps.title: Select central lever
steps.text: GPO, Intune, gold image, golden config, IaC or Azure Policy first

steps.title: Pilot and test
steps.text: Apply to a pilot group and check compatibility
steps.label: Owner: tower lead

steps.title: Approve and roll out
steps.text: Through change management, in the tower's change window
steps.label: Owner: tower lead

steps.title: Revalidate
steps.text: Reassessment confirms the control is applied estate-wide
steps.label: Owner: programme team

steps.title: Close with evidence
steps.text: Evidence logged; progress shown on the risk reduction dashboard
steps.label: Reported monthly

loop_note: Findings still open go back for another lever

banner: One repeatable path: fixed centrally, proven by reassessment, or governed as an exception.
